title: Contains Duplicate
summary: Scan a list of integers for a value that occurs in two different positions.
statement: Scan a list of integers for a value that occurs in two different positions. Return a boolean indicating whether you found one.

examples.explanation: A single position cannot form a repeat.

hints: Conceptual: A repeat can occur anywhere in the list.
Directional: Keep a set of values already seen.
Implementation: Check membership before inserting each value. Stop at the first hit.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) expected time and O(n) auxiliary space for n values. A set stores each distinct value at most once.
